height_metric: maximum bit length of absolute numerator and denominator of affine x and y of nQ and -m*nQ
prefix_rank_law: At each M=1..21, insert reduced P=-m*nQ plus m times reduced nQ for m in {2,6}, n<=M, sign-fold all 42 nonidentity points, and compute rank over F43
status_law: Preserve full prefix cells and cap/error if encountered; report exact coordinate heights, not an asymptotic inference
